goal: Prevent unauthenticated clients from causing denial of service by tying up all HTTP RPC workers
Ensure legitimate authenticated RPC requests are not blocked by invalid login attempts
agreement: Strong support for fixing this DoS vector over keeping password guessing slow (willcl-ark)
Resolved concern that removing the delay increases brute-force guessing rates (willcl-ark)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it eliminates an easy denial-of-service attack against node operators using RPC
Worker starvation from failed requests is a more practical threat than password guessing
